contract.headline: A 48h timelock covers contract-upgrade (eip1967_admin, proxyAdmin). pause (PAUSE_ADMIN_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) has NO established delay — timelock: none. The delay protects the code and not the supply.
contract.headline_basis: Derived from the layer rows below, not authored here, so it changes when the walk changes.

paths.name: ProxyAdmin (sUSDai)
paths.hand_walk: At Arbitrum block 503282689, the proxy's EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots returned 0x88a233b8...7198b and this ProxyAdmin. owner() returned TimelockController 0x0eea1ee0...5639b and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. Live hasRole checks reproduced GOV_SAFE as proposer, canceller, and executor, OPS_SAFE as executor, and the timelock itself as DEFAULT_ADMIN. updateDelay(0) succeeding when eth_call used the timelock as sender and reverting for 0x...dEaD tests onlySelf access, not reachability. A delay reduction must itself be scheduled through the current 48h delay. This is the SAME terminal governance used by USDai, reached through a DIFFERENT ProxyAdmin.

paths.name: SafeProxy (PAUSE_ADMIN_ROLE)
paths.hand_walk: Live hasRole(PAUSE_ADMIN_ROLE, this SafeProxy) returned true; getThreshold() returned 2 and getOwners() returned three addresses. Verified implementation source gates both pause() and unpause() on this role. Pausing blocks deposits, redemption requests, withdrawals, redemptions, operator changes, and bridge mint/burn.

paths.name: OPS_SAFE
paths.hand_walk: Live hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, OPS_SAFE) returned true and getRoleAdmin(PAUSE_ADMIN_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. The Safe is 3-of-3, so it can grant pause authority to any address without a timelock. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history was netted and the live role checks confirmed the current direct holders.

layers.target_name: Staked USDai redemption queue and loan allocation

paths.name: SafeProxy (STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE)
paths.hand_walk: Live hasRole(STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE, this SafeProxy) returned true; getThreshold() returned 3 and getOwners() returned four addresses. Verified source gives this role serviceRedemptions, base-yield harvesting, and loan deposit/cancellation functions. RedemptionLogic imposes a fixed 30-day eligibility window, but only serviceRedemptions advances matured requests and it may service a caller-selected share amount subject to available liquid USDai. The Safe can therefore withhold queue advancement and chooses loanTermsHash, amount, rate or expiration when deploying vault liquidity. No separate sUSDai oracle setter was found in the implementation; totalAssets derives from deposits, base yield, and tracked LoanRouter positions.

paths.name: OPS_SAFE
paths.hand_walk: Live getRoleAdmin(STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, held by this 3-of-3 Safe. It can grant the strategy role to itself or any address without delay, independently of the current 3-of-4 Strategy Admin Safe.

paths.name: OAdapter (sUSDai LayerZero OFT adapter)
paths.hand_walk: Verified constructor arguments fix this adapter as _bridgeAdapter; adapter.token() returned sUSDai, endpoint() returned LayerZero V2 Endpoint 0x1a4407...28c, and owner() returned OPS_SAFE. Controlled eth_call showed mint(address,uint256) succeeds from the adapter and reverts from 0x...dEaD. The current implementation uses the immutable onlyBridgeAdapter gate, not the now-revoked historical BRIDGE_ADMIN_ROLE. Adapter owner peer configuration is consequently an undelayed cross-chain mint path.

verified implementation source on 2026-09-09. Read-only calls only; no
